Reedman Charlie Gabriel is a native of New Orleans who continues a family musical tradition that goes back four generations. In the month of January, 2020, when this interview was conducted, Charlie was awarded a Lifetime Achievement in Music Award by OffBeat Magazine. During this interview he reminisced about his career as a saxophonist and clarinetist in Detroit and his eventual return to New Orleans for a steady gig with the Preservation Hall Jazz Band.
Charlie was interviewed in New Orleans, Louisiana on January 9, 2020 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
I’m very happy to have Charlie Gabriel with me today. My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Thanks for your time.
Oh thank you for having me. I really appreciate it.
